'''2017 MPC Steve Harpster LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
